_meta.note: 一个任务一个文件。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#000.src: Find out what's happening at the theatre.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#000.dst: 查明剧院里发生了什么事。

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#001.src: Interesting to see a Human wanting to see a Dwarven play!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#001.dst: 真有意思，居然有人类想看矮人的戏！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#001.speaker: Lozeg

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#002.src: The only play we're performing is the annual Victory Festival.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#002.dst: 我们唯一上演的戏是一年一度的胜利节。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#002.speaker: Lozeg

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#003.src: The entry cost is [{~} Emerald Block]
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#003.dst: 入场费是 [{~} 绿宝石块]
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#003.speaker: Lozeg

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#005.src: Just take a seat and enjoy the show.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#005.dst: 找个位子坐下，好好欣赏演出吧。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#005.speaker: Lozeg

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#006.src: Wait, is that- Hey, {u}! It's so good to see you!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#006.dst: 等等，那是——嘿，{u}！见到你真好！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#006.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#007.src: Hello, to the people of Gavel, glad to see so many here!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#007.dst: Gavel 的各位好，很高兴看到这么多人来！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#007.speaker: Narrator

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#008.src: I hope you'll enjoy the play and that it'll be very educational too. I will be tonight's narrator.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#008.dst: 希望各位会喜欢这出戏，也希望它能让大家学到很多。我是今晚的旁白。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#008.speaker: Narrator

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#009.src: Pheeeew. I think we outran the villagers.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#009.dst: 呼——。我想我们甩掉村民了。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#009.speaker: Babbi

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#010.src: I think we are safe here in the mountains. Oh look. Shiny ores. This is like a gold mine.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#010.dst: 我想我们在这山里很安全。噢你看。闪亮的矿石。这简直就像金矿。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#010.speaker: Dwarfi

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#011.src: These nice minerals are very nice, let us start digging.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#011.dst: 这些很好的矿物非常好，我们开始挖吧。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#011.speaker: Dwarfi

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#013.src: I am a dangerous monster and I will not let you mine these diamonds. We are the Doguns, and we will kill you!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#013.dst: 我是危险的怪物，我不会让你们挖这些钻石。我们是 Dogun，我们要杀了你们！！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#013.speaker: Demon

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#014.src: Graoaoro. I will eat you all for my afternoon demon luncheon.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#014.dst: 嗷嗷嗷。我要把你们全吃了，当我下午的恶魔午餐。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#014.speaker: Demon

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#016.dst: 哞哈哈哈哈！滚开，小矮人们。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#016.speaker: Demon

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#017.dst: 啊啊啊。我要死了……要死了！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#017.speaker: Arock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#018.src: MOAHAHAHA. WE WILL KILL ALL OF YOU.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#018.dst: 哞哈哈哈。我们要杀光你们。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#018.speaker: Demon

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#019.src: We need to forge better weapons so we can fight back.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#019.dst: 我们得打造更好的武器才能反击。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#019.speaker: Babbi

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#020.src: Good idea! We will use our intelligence to slay the demons.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#020.dst: 好主意！我们要用我们的智慧屠杀恶魔。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#020.speaker: Gagly

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#021.src: YOU CANNOT BEAT US, WE CAN SUMMON DRAGONS WITH OUR MAGIC.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#021.dst: 你们打不过我们的，我们能用魔法召唤巨龙。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#021.speaker: Demon

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#022.src: Dragons are no match for us?? CHARGE!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#022.dst: 巨龙根本不是我们的对手？？冲啊！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#022.speaker: Gagly

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#023.src: We have won. Hooray. And now we have established a great citadel, {p}!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#023.dst: 我们赢了。万岁。现在我们建立了一座伟大的城堡，{p}！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#023.speaker: Gagly

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#024.src: The dwarven intellect beat the sheer power of the demons magic.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#024.dst: 矮人的智慧打败了恶魔纯粹的魔法力量。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#024.speaker: Gagly

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#026.src: I hope you enjoyed the show, and learned something new today!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#026.dst: 希望各位喜欢这场演出，今天也学到了新东西！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#026.speaker: Narrator

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#027.src: We are continuing the celebration at the old Demon City. Follow the red banners outside {p} to get there.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#027.dst: 我们会在旧恶魔城继续庆祝。沿着 {p} 外面的红色旗帜就能到那里。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#027.speaker: Narrator

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#029.src: Ugh, that was awful. Don't believe anything you see here, human. History is written by the victors.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#029.dst: 呃，真是糟透了。别相信你在这里看到的任何东西，人类。历史是胜利者写的。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#029.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#030.src: Make your way to the Dogun Festival by following the red banners outside {p}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#030.dst: 沿着 {p} 外面的红色旗帜前往 Dogun 节。

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#031.src: Welcome one and all! Dwarven brothers and sisters, guests and visitors!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#031.dst: 欢迎各位！矮人兄弟姐妹们，宾客与访客们！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#031.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#032.src: If I could draw your attention to the wooden stage in the north, we can begin.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#032.dst: 请大家把注意力转向北边的木制舞台，我们就可以开始了。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#032.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#033.src: Welcome to the annual festival where we celebrate victory over the foul demons...The Doguns!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#033.dst: 欢迎来到一年一度、庆祝战胜邪恶恶魔的节日……Dogun！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#033.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#034.src: Now, if I can get you to turn around to face the bonfire, we've prepared a lovely firecasting show for you all while we prepare!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#034.dst: 现在，请大家转过身面向营火，我们准备期间，为各位安排了一场精彩的火焰施法表演！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#034.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#035.src: Wow, I didn't know Dwarves could learn such magic! Beats the heck out of firecrackers!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#035.dst: 哇，我不知道矮人也能学会这种魔法！比鞭炮强多了！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#035.speaker: Mahou

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#036.src: Magnificent! Thank you very much to our fire casters. Now, ladies and gents, your attention to the main stage please!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#036.dst: 太精彩了！非常感谢我们的火焰施法者。现在，女士们先生们，请把注意力转向主舞台！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#036.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#037.src: For the last {~} years we have captured renegade Doguns that escaped the war, and this year is no exception!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#037.dst: 过去 {~} 年来，我们一直在抓捕战后逃窜的叛逆 Dogun，今年也不例外！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#037.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#038.src: We shall now entomb the foul demon to join the ranks of the other Doguns on display.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#038.dst: 现在，我们将封存这个邪恶的恶魔，让它加入其他展示中的 Dogun 行列。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#038.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#040.src: Note its magical might, its aggressive nature, its intense heat, and its fierce appearance.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#040.dst: 请注意它的魔法力量、它凶暴的本性、它炽烈的高温，还有它狰狞的外表。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#040.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#041.src: All no match for the ingenuity and comeradery of the Dwarven nations!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#041.dst: 但这些全都比不上矮人各国的聪明才智与同袍情谊！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#041.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#042.src: M-Monsters... You all...are the demons here...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#042.dst: 怪、怪物……你们……才是这里的恶魔……
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#042.speaker: Dogun

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#043.src: Every year, every year, every single YEAR you do this. You all need to open your god-blessed eyes for once!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#043.dst: 每年，每年，每一年你们都这样做。你们全都该睁开你们那双受神祝福的眼睛看看了！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#043.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#044.src: Do you all really believe everything they tell you? Do you all just lap it up like dogs?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#044.dst: 他们告诉你们的每件事你们真的都相信吗？你们就像狗一样全都舔下去吗？！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#044.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#045.src: Our side won the war, but does that really mean we were in the right? I'll tell you right now, it doesn't!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#045.dst: 我们这一方赢了战争，但那真的代表我们是对的吗？我现在就告诉你们，不是！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#045.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#046.src: We all see it- The Doguns have feelings, family and thoughts, just like anyone else here!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#046.dst: 我们都看得出来——Dogun 跟这里的每个人一样，有感情、有家人、有思想！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#046.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#047.src: You are encasing live Doguns for entertainment. Public execution! This twisted display is more demonic than they ever could dream to be!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#047.dst: 你们为了娱乐把活生生的 Dogun 封起来。这是公开处刑！这种扭曲的展示，比他们做梦都想不到的还要邪恶！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#047.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#048.src: Guards! Get this propaganda spewing half pint to the Molten Core Prison, north side.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#048.dst: 守卫！把这个满嘴宣传的小矮子带去北边的熔核监狱。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#048.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#049.src: Come along, sir. Let's not make more of a scene.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#049.dst: 跟我走吧，先生。我们别再闹得更难看了。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#049.speaker: Dwarven Guard

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#050.src: Why would Axelus say something so blatantly wrong?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#050.dst: Axelus 为什么要说这种明显错误的话？
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#050.speaker: Crowd

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#051.src: What was he talking about? That was all nonsense!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#051.dst: 他到底在说什么？全是胡说八道！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#051.speaker: Crowd

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#052.src: Are they really taking him to the Molten Core? You've heard the horror stories about there, right?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#052.dst: 他们真的要把他带去熔核监狱？你听过那里的恐怖故事吧？
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#052.speaker: Crowd

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#053.src: Well, the expression 'no hope blows from the north' came from there, since it's on the north side...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#053.dst: 嗯，“北风吹来无希望”这句话就是从那里来的，因为它在北边……
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#053.speaker: Crowd

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#054.src: Apologies, all. I shall provide us all with a quick way back to {p} on the floor here. We hope you enjoyed the show, despite the interruption!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#054.dst: 抱歉了，各位。我会在这边的地上为大家提供一条快速回 {p} 的路。尽管有这段插曲，希望大家还是喜欢这场演出！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#054.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#055.src: Find out more about the hysterical dwarf in {p}'s prison.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#055.dst: 到 {p} 的监狱，进一步了解那个歇斯底里的矮人。

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#056.src: I see I got your attention. Interested in the truth.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#056.dst: 看来我引起你的注意了。对真相感兴趣。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#056.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#057.src: I'm no conspiracy nut. The Dwarves have been lied to for hundreds of years about the war.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#057.dst: 我不是阴谋论疯子。几百年来，矮人一直被关于那场战争的谎言蒙骗。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#057.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#058.src: I have seen the truth. But my word isn't enough, is it? Seeing is believing, after all.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#058.dst: 我看过真相。但光凭我的话还不够，对吧？毕竟眼见为凭。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#058.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#059.src: Hopefully I will see you soon, {u}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#059.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#060.src: Pick up Axelus' note and head to the location at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#060.dst: 捡起 Axelus 的纸条，前往 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的地点。

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#063.src: Well, now you have read what I read. The truth...or the lie.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#063.dst: 好了，现在你读到了我读过的东西。真相……或者谎言。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#063.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#064.src: My people are tyrants and conquerors...but they are also good. The people have been brainwashed.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#064.dst: 我的族人是暴君和征服者……但他们也是善良的。人民被洗脑了。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#064.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#065.src: Many things are about to happen. If you want to know more, come to house number {~} in {p}. I'll be waiting.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#065.dst: 很多事就要发生了。如果你想知道更多，就来 {p} 的 {~} 号房子。我会等你。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#065.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#066.src: Search for house {~} in {p} like Axelus said.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#066.dst: 照 Axelus 说的，在 {p} 寻找 {~} 号房子。

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#067.src: Talk to Axelus in the Coalition Base.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#067.dst: 在联盟基地与 Axelus 交谈。

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#068.src: Ah, you made it. Come and meet Korzim
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#068.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#070.src: We...are those who...want peace. I am son...of the Dogun Chief... I have...been banished.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#070.dst: 我们……是那些……想要和平的人。我是……Dogun 族长的儿子……我已经……被放逐了。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#070.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#071.src: The coalition is a small group of believers in the truth. The Doguns aren't demons, and the Dwarves aren't all brainwashed.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#071.dst: 联盟是一小群相信真相的人。Dogun 不是恶魔，矮人也不是全都被洗脑了。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#071.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#072.src: But of course, we have to live in hiding. The Doguns won’t tolerate Dwarves and the Dwarves hunt traitors and "Demons".
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#072.dst: 不过我们当然只能躲起来生活。Dogun 容不下矮人，而矮人会追捕叛徒和“恶魔”。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#072.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#073.src: Right now, we're trying to convince the public. But it's proving difficult, if not impossible.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#073.dst: 我们现在正试着说服大众。但事实证明这很难，甚至根本不可能。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#073.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#074.src: It isn't {~} years ago. We have the technology and supply chains to live here peacefully, but they just won't listen!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#074.dst: 现在已经不是 {~} 年前了。我们有技术和补给链，能在这里和平生活，可他们就是不听！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#074.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#075.src: We have...a plan... To win over...my people...that is.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#075.dst: 我们有……一个计划……要赢得……我族人的……支持。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#075.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#076.src: Korzim has told us that dragon bone is sacred to his people. We had to make some connections, but we have a way to get it now.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#076.dst: Korzim 告诉我们，龙骨对他的族人来说是神圣的。我们得打通一些关系，不过现在已经有办法弄到了。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#076.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#077.src: If you want, you could come with us. We can explain more of the situation later. Exit's through the back.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#077.dst: 如果你愿意，可以跟我们一起去。之后我们再多跟你解释情况。出口在后面。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#077.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#078.src: Follow the group on the mission.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#080.src: The others...are just up ahead. I'll let you through...our tunnel.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#080.dst: 其他人……就在前面。我让你……穿过我们的隧道。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#080.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#081.src: We use.. earth and.. fire.. elements. It is slow... like us.. but powerful.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#081.dst: 我们使用……土和……火……元素。它很慢……像我们一样……但很强大。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#081.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#083.src: We got this drill all the way from Corkus. Axelus had to pay a king's ransom to buy it, but this ought to work!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#083.dst: 我们这台钻机是大老远从 Corkus 弄来的。Axelus 花了一大笔钱才买到，不过这应该管用！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#083.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#085.src: AAAAGH! Idiot Corkus swindlers! Damn it all! How many emeralds did we waste?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#085.dst: 啊啊啊啊！Corkus 那些白痴骗子！该死！我们到底浪费了多少绿宝石？！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#085.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#086.src: Ugh, do you have any experience with machines? You might have some idea of how in the hell to fix this hunk of junk.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#086.dst: 呃，你有操作机器的经验吗？也许你知道到底该怎么修好这堆破铜烂铁。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#086.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#087.src: Fantastic, {u}! We got the bone! Couldn't have done it without you.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#087.dst: 太棒了，{u}！我们拿到骨头了！没有你我们办不到。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#087.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#088.src: You can take it back to the coalition base. Barden and I will need to pack up before we join you.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#088.dst: 你可以先把它带回联盟基地。我和 Barden 得先收拾东西再过去找你。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#088.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#089.src: Just knock on the black block in front of the cave we arrived in.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#089.dst: 敲一敲我们来时那个洞穴前面的黑色方块就行。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#089.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#090.src: Head back to the Coalition Base through the tunnel.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#090.dst: 穿过隧道回到联盟基地。

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#093.src: Dragon bone is one of the hardest substances in all the provinces. It's extremely rare.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#093.dst: 龙骨是所有省份里最坚硬的物质之一。极为稀有。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#093.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#094.src: We're going to present this to the Dogun chief as tribute. We need to tidy it up.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#094.dst: 我们要把它当作贡品献给 Dogun 族长。得先把它整理干净。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#094.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#095.src: Could you get [{~} Repair Kit] from the eastern part of the base?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#095.dst: 你能去基地东边拿 [{~} 修理包] 吗？
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#095.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#096.src: Retrieve the [Repair Kit] in the eastern part of the base.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#096.dst: 到基地东边取回 [修理包]。

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#098.src: There are voices behind this wall, and the trail ends here.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#098.dst: 这面墙后面有人声，而且线索到这里就断了。

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#099.src: We have no vaults here. Must be traitors... The King really wants to see Axelus.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#099.dst: 我们这里没有金库。一定是叛徒……国王很想见到 Axelus。

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#100.src: Stand back! I'll ready the charges...

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#102.src: No, no, ignore the repair kit! There's no time to worry about that!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#102.dst: 不，不，别管修理包了！没时间顾那个了！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#102.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#103.src: Our position has been compromised, they blew our doors wide open! We have to evacuate immediately.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#103.dst: 我们的位置暴露了，他们把我们的门炸开了！我们必须马上撤离。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#103.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#104.src: We've never been caught like this before, they never knew we really had Doguns on our side.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#104.dst: 我们从来没被这样逮到过，他们从来不知道我们真的有 Dogun 站在我们这边。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#104.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#105.src: We need to get to safety right now! The least explored area is the Upper Heights.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#105.dst: 我们现在得马上去安全的地方！最少人探索过的区域是上高地。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#105.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#106.src: Everyone, out! Now! They won't follow through the rough terrain!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#106.dst: 所有人，出去！马上！他们不会穿过崎岖的地形追上来的！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#106.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#107.src: Find your way up to the Dogun Village through the tunnel.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#107.dst: 穿过隧道，找到通往 Dogun 村的路。

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#108.src: We'll stay around here, we aren't welcome in the village.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#108.dst: 我们会留在这附近，村子不欢迎我们。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#108.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#109.src: But... bring them... the dragon bone as a gift... If they accept it... they might accept us.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#109.dst: 不过……把龙骨……当作礼物带给他们……如果他们收下……也许就会接纳我们。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#109.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#110.src: You are free to enter the village but we will stay back and wait until the coast is clear. Keep going.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#110.dst: 你可以自由进入村子，不过我们会留在后面，等确定安全再说。继续走吧。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#110.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#111.src: What is... that on the... cliff to the south?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#111.dst: 南边……悬崖上的……那是什么？
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#111.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#112.src: Hey, aren't those...Doguns?! A whole settlement...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#112.dst: 嘿，那些不是……Dogun 吗？！一整个聚落……
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#112.speaker: Dwarven Scout

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#113.src: They've been gathering forces! We must inform {p} immediately!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#113.dst: 他们一直在集结兵力！我们必须马上通知 {p}！
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#113.speaker: Dwarven Scout

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#114.src: Human. Come talk to me.. Now.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#114.dst: 人类。过来跟我谈谈……马上。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#114.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#116.src: Human... That Dwarf, he saw us...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#116.dst: 人类……那个矮人，他看到我们了……
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#116.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#117.src: They will... destroy us... If he reports... back to {p}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#117.dst: 他们会……消灭我们……如果他回去……报告 {p}。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#117.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#118.src: We need to... prepare our defenses. We need all the... help we can get.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#118.dst: 我们需要……准备防御。我们需要所有……能得到的帮助。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#118.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#119.src: Wait... What are... you holding? Dragon bone...? Just what we need...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#119.dst: 等等……你拿着……什么？龙骨……？正是我们需要的……
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#119.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#120.src: Human... if you promise to help us... I will grant you access to... our secret elevators... You can get up and... down the heights with those.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#120.dst: 人类……如果你答应帮助我们……我就允许你使用……我们的秘密升降梯……你可以用它们在高地……上下移动。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#120.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#121.src: Please return to... us when you reach level {~}. Take this... badge so the... others recognize you... as an ally. One of the elevators is... to the south.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#121.dst: 等你到了 {~} 级……请回到……我们这里。收下这枚……徽章，这样……其他人就会认出你……是盟友。其中一座升降梯……在南边。
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#121.speaker: Plario
